basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 20.' and it opens 'Vers. 20. Clamor Sodomorum et Gomorrhaeorum multiplicatus est. Ut beatus Gregorius dicit,'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 20. Clamor Sodomorum et Gomorrhaeorum multiplicatus est. Ut beatus Gregorius dicit, peccatum cum voce est peccatum in actione: peccatum autem cum clamore est peccatum cum libertate. Quia ergo Sodomitae libere et inverecunde omnem impudicitiam exercebant, imo in pessimis sceleribus | laetabantur et exsultabant, ideo clamor eorum dicitur pervenisse ad Deum.
